headline: Your Ramipril refill was picked up and the doctor wants your blood pressure plan kept the same, but you should check your blood pressure three times in a row each morning and consider Tylenol for your knee, since ibuprofen can raise blood pressure.

followUps.title: Get Tylenol for your knee pain
followUps.detail: The doctor suggested trying Tylenol for your knee pain, since ibuprofen can raise your blood pressure over time. You said you would pick some up on your way out today.

instructions.text: Check your blood pressure every morning before you have coffee or breakfast. Sit quietly for a few minutes with your feet flat on the floor. Take it three times in a row, back to back. Ignore the first reading and average the second and third readings.

unchanged.text: The doctor said to keep things the way they are. Your blood pressure medicine plan, including Ramipril 5 milligrams, stays the same.

openQuestions.text: It was not said whether you should stop the ibuprofen 400 milligrams you take two or three times a day for your knee pain.
